0.name: TEXT_CMNFATSHOP1N4FIELD_00583_SIULMET_000_001
0.description: My apologies, traveler. It seems my courier has been waylaid, and I have nothing to offer you until she arrives.

1.name: TEXT_CMNFATSHOP1N4FIELD_00583_SYSTEM_000_002
1.description: You must progress further through the Shadowbringers main scenario in order to access this vendor's wares.

2.name: TEXT_CMNFATSHOP1N4FIELD_00583_SIULMET_001_001
2.description: Welcome, traveler. I am an authorized trader representing the Crystalline Mean in the acquisition of bicolor gemstones. If you find yourself in possession of any such gems, I can offer you a number of items provided by the facets in exchange.

3.name: TEXT_CMNFATSHOP1N4FIELD_00583_SYSTEM_999_001
3.description: You may now trade with Siulmet!

4.name: TEXT_CMNFATSHOP1N4FIELD_00583_SYSTEM_001_002
4.description: You now have access to this region's gemstone exchange, through which bicolor gemstones can be traded for a variety of rare and exclusive items.

5.name: TEXT_CMNFATSHOP1N4FIELD_00583_SYSTEM_001_003
5.description: Successfully completing local FATEs will allow for the delivery of more valuable goods, increasing the number of items available for trade.

6.name: TEXT_CMNFATSHOP1N4FIELD_00583_SIULMET_002_001
6.description: This is everything I have available at the moment. It is unfortunately too dangerous to transport more valuable items across Lakeland, what with Nightshade harrying everyone from merchants to the Crystarium guard.

7.name: TEXT_CMNFATSHOP1N4FIELD_00583_SIULMET_002_002
7.description: Lakeland has seen more days without incident of late─enough for my couriers to risk delivery of a few more valuable items. Perhaps you will find something to your liking.

8.name: TEXT_CMNFATSHOP1N4FIELD_00583_SIULMET_002_003
8.description: I can scarce believe how safe the roads in Lakeland have become. At last, I can stock the best the facets have to offer!

9.name: TEXT_CMNFATSHOP1N4FIELD_00583_ZUMUTT_000_001
9.description: Lali-ho! I'd love to offer you some fine dwarven crafts, but I ain't set up just yet. Come back and see me later, you hear?

10.name: TEXT_CMNFATSHOP1N4FIELD_00583_ZUMUTT_001_001
10.description: Lali-ho! Can I interest you in some dwarven crafts? Other Kholusian fineries? It'll only cost you a few bicolor gemstones!

11.name: TEXT_CMNFATSHOP1N4FIELD_00583_SYSTEM_999_002
11.description: You may now trade with Zumutt!

12.name: TEXT_CMNFATSHOP1N4FIELD_00583_ZUMUTT_002_001
12.description: Take a look and see if there's anything you like! Might be able to trade for some more goods to offer you if things got a bit less...murderous outside of the village, but for now this is what I have.

13.name: TEXT_CMNFATSHOP1N4FIELD_00583_ZUMUTT_002_002
13.description: Dwaaarven crafts! Fine dwarven craft─oh, pleasure to see you! You'll notice I have a decent selection of wares available. It's been a bit easier to trade for materials and the like of late.

14.name: TEXT_CMNFATSHOP1N4FIELD_00583_ZUMUTT_002_003
14.description: Dwaaarven crafts! And by that I mean trade has really picked up 'round here, on account of the safer roads and all. Have a look!

15.name: TEXT_CMNFATSHOP1N4FIELD_00583_HALDEN_000_001
15.description: “You'll be the face of the business, Halden,” he says! What business? He hasn't even brought me the invento─oh, sorry. Didn't see you there. I would ask if I can help you, but I probably...can't?

16.name: TEXT_CMNFATSHOP1N4FIELD_00583_HALDEN_001_001
16.description: Very well. You can do this, Halden... Ahem! Give me your bicolor gemstones! Oh, that's not what I meant. I meant...I have stuff. Things. That I could trade you. Does that sound...good?

17.name: TEXT_CMNFATSHOP1N4FIELD_00583_SYSTEM_999_003
17.description: You may now trade with Halden!

18.name: TEXT_CMNFATSHOP1N4FIELD_00583_HALDEN_002_001
18.description: Right. The things. The issue is, I don't have too much right now, it being so dangerous to keep valuables in stock out here... You can see what I <hex:021A020203>do<hex:021A020103> have, though!

19.name: TEXT_CMNFATSHOP1N4FIELD_00583_HALDEN_002_002
19.description: Oh, are you here for the things? I mean...the wares. The wares, yes. I've actually begun taking deliveries of a few more sorts, if you're interested!

20.name: TEXT_CMNFATSHOP1N4FIELD_00583_HALDEN_002_003
20.description: You've noticed that the trade routes have been much safer of late? Well, it's allowed me to procure some truly excellent wares. I'm sure that you'll find them to your liking! And...thank you for your patience.

21.name: TEXT_CMNFATSHOP1N4FIELD_00583_SULLAD_000_001
21.description: This is dull! Dull, dull, dull! How <hex:021A020203>do<hex:021A020103> you mortals tolerate this “setting up shop” business? I've been waiting for my goods to arrive for <hex:021A020203>ages<hex:021A020103>.

22.name: TEXT_CMNFATSHOP1N4FIELD_00583_SULLAD_001_001
22.description: Oh, mortal! Purchase something from my shop! Spend your... Hm, what <hex:021A020203>do<hex:021A020103> you mortals trade at these shops of yours, anyhow? Shiny rocks or something, I expect? Very well! Spend your shiny rocks here!

23.name: TEXT_CMNFATSHOP1N4FIELD_00583_SYSTEM_999_004
23.description: You may now trade with Sul Lad!

24.name: TEXT_CMNFATSHOP1N4FIELD_00583_SULLAD_002_001
24.description: I only have a few items that your lot would want at the moment─my couriers keep getting turned into hedges. It's hilarious, of course, but I'm not sure I'll ever have a proper shop at this rate. You'll peruse what I have, though. Or else.

25.name: TEXT_CMNFATSHOP1N4FIELD_00583_SULLAD_002_002
25.description: Now, mortal! Peruse my wares! I have new things─I have an <hex:021A020203>inventory<hex:021A020103>. Isn't that exciting?

26.name: TEXT_CMNFATSHOP1N4FIELD_00583_SULLAD_002_003
26.description: Ahem! Welcome, mortal, welcome! I've taken deliveries. I have inventory─I have stock! Hee hee! Yes, I <hex:021A020203>am<hex:021A020103> rather pleased with myself, why do you ask?

27.name: TEXT_CMNFATSHOP1N4FIELD_00583_NACILLE_000_001
27.description: Welcome, traveler. It is my intention to establish a small trading post here. I hope that you will return once I have everything in order.

28.name: TEXT_CMNFATSHOP1N4FIELD_00583_NACILLE_001_001
28.description: The time has come for the Viis to share more of our culture with the outside world, small as it has become. As my contribution to these efforts, I am happy to offer a variety of goods from the forest in exchange for any bicolor gemstones you might happen upon.

29.name: TEXT_CMNFATSHOP1N4FIELD_00583_SYSTEM_999_005
29.description: You may now trade with Nacille!

30.name: TEXT_CMNFATSHOP1N4FIELD_00583_NACILLE_002_001
30.description: I have only a small stock of wares, but you are welcome to them. If our hunters were able roam further from Fanow, I might be able to offer more, but as it stands we must prioritize their safety.

31.name: TEXT_CMNFATSHOP1N4FIELD_00583_NACILLE_002_002
31.description: Please do have a look at what I am offering for trade. Much of it you will not find outside of the Greatwood.

32.name: TEXT_CMNFATSHOP1N4FIELD_00583_NACILLE_002_003
32.description: You might notice that I now have a rather impressive selection─our hunters have been able to supply me with rare finds from throughout the wood. They speak to the richness of Viis culture, and I think you will find much here to your liking.

33.name: TEXT_CMNFATSHOP1N4FIELD_00583_GOUSHSOOAN_000_001
33.description: If you came to trade, finless one, I'm afraid you are destined for disappointment. My goods have not yet arrived.

34.name: TEXT_CMNFATSHOP1N4FIELD_00583_GOUSHSOOAN_001_001
34.description: Trade my goods for your bicolor gemstones? I sssuppose I could─or rather, should. That's what I'm here for.

35.name: TEXT_CMNFATSHOP1N4FIELD_00583_SYSTEM_999_006
35.description: You may now trade with Goushs Ooan!

36.name: TEXT_CMNFATSHOP1N4FIELD_00583_GOUSHSOOAN_002_001
36.description: You'll doubtless be disappointed by the paltry selection I have to offer at the moment. But I'm ssstuck here whether or not either of us like it, so you may as well have a look.

37.name: TEXT_CMNFATSHOP1N4FIELD_00583_GOUSHSOOAN_002_002
37.description: Very well, peruse my goods. Honestly, I wouldn't recommend them. Though I sssuppose I wouldn't recommend <hex:021A020203>against<hex:021A020103> them, either.

38.name: TEXT_CMNFATSHOP1N4FIELD_00583_GOUSHSOOAN_002_003
38.description: Here for my wares, finless one? I actually have a rather fine ssselection now, and trade is flourishing. It...will take some getting used to.
